text: Radhika Nair, speaking from Swaraj Round in Thrissur. Leave the temple weekly order TR-12 alone, that was 637 rupees and it is finished. The wedding order TR-4816 was packed on 2026-03-14. I am speaking on 3 April 2026. They are still waiting on the jasmine rope, the lotus bunch, and the marigold toran. Jasmine came to 2150.25 rupees and the lotus to 980.75 rupees. Nobody wrote a delivery challan in the book.

wedding_order.instruction: Wedding order Radhika is speaking about

still_wanted.instruction: Each garland or bunch still waited on

blossom_cost.instruction: Jasmine cost and lotus cost added together
